notes.title: ⚙️ MARKET GARDEN - Update 0.1 - Fixes & Improvements!
notes.content:
[h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45519444/74399c907c2e77de19ca30227ecf5a94902c3e79.png"][/img][/h1][p][/p][h1][b]Hello friends! 👋[/b][/h1][p][b]Your feedback over the past few days has been absolutely priceless — thank you from the bottom of my heart. ❤️[/b][/p][p][/p][p]This update brings a mix of bug fixes, ultrawide monitor support, community-suggested changes, and a range of quality-of-life improvements.[/p][p][/p][p][b]📝 Note:[/b][/p][p]It’s not required to delete your old profile and create a new one — but it’s recommended, especially if you run into any issues.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]✅ Ultrawide monitors support added[/b][/p][p][i]Improved experience for ultrawide monitor users. This feature is still experimental — if you run into any issues, don’t hesitate to reach out![/i][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Seamless input switching[/b][/p][p][i]Improved behavior when using both a controller and mouse/keyboard. You can now switch between them at any time — no need to disconnect your controller![/i][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Music volume setting[/b] [/p][p][i]Adjust music volume to your liking.[/i][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]New aim sensitivity option[/b] [/p][p]Customize sensitivity while aiming for better precision.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Bolt-action improvements[/b] [/p][p]No more instant snapback! After firing, the view now stays zoomed-in briefly so you can see if your shot landed before entering the reload animation. Also, when holding the right mouse button, you’ll automatically return to aiming after cycling the bolt.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Invert controls (vertical axis only)[/b][/p][p]Invert mouse option now works as intended — only the vertical axis is affected.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Custom key bindings for weapon switching[/b] [/p][p]You can now rebind keyboard keys for switching weapons.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Pixelization effect disabled by default[/b] [/p][p]I noticed many of you turning pixelization off right away — I hear you! It’s now set to 0 by default for a crisper look.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Faster item pickup[/b][/p][p]Items are now picked up more quickly for smoother gameplay.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Smoke grenade performance improvements[/b] [/p][p]Reduced the performance impact of smoke grenades, especially on Steam Deck.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]MP40 aim alignment adjusted[/b]
Improved alignment for better accuracy.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Friendly fire from allies disabled[/b]
Allies will no longer deal damage to the player.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Steam Deck mouse support[/b] [/p][p]Due to new seamless input switching - mouse now works correctly on Steam Deck.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Improved AI line of sight behavior[/b] [/p][p]AI now handles obstacles and line of sight more intelligently.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Reload bug fix after UI change[/b] [/p][p]Resolved issue where reload prompt could behave incorrectly after weapon change.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Various minor fixes and polish[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]If your suggestion didn’t make it into this update — don’t worry![/b][/p][p]This is just one of many improvements to come. If you run into any issues or have an idea, feel free to reach out![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again to all of you — and have fun playing the improved MARKET GARDEN demo![/p]
